_comment: Add these scripts to your project's package.json scripts section
_note: agent-factory-cli must be at same level as your Playwright project folder. Update path if different.
_allure: Allure is OPTIONAL. Install with: npm i -D allure-playwright (and the allure CLI for generate/open). Requires the per-run RUN_ID config from playwright.config.template.ts (AH Rule 31) so each run keeps its own allure-results/ folder - that retention is what makes the trend graph work. Consumed by /test-closure Step 4B as EVIDENCE only; progress.md stays the pass/fail oracle.
